origin: Preliminary dirty-tree runs, not clean acceptance

observations.finding: Result domain projections omitted the required full metric map
observations.resolution: Native per-domain statistics and all27formulas added

observations.finding: Generic import projection demanded new object nodes for already admitted semantic/local IDs
observations.resolution: One derived-result DTO admission with actual attempt/case links; fenced result pointer

observations.finding: Feedback fixture modified the wrong profile index
observations.resolution: Select actual frozen profile by ID

observations.finding: Replay test supplied the new revision with an old idempotency key
observations.resolution: Replay original request/revision; conflicting requests remain rejected

observations.finding: Two optional-audit diagnostics with no affected scoring component failed the result issue DTO
observations.resolution: Retain them as diagnostic audit status/stage evidence, separate from genuine score issues

observations.finding: Full repeated numeric matrices caused actual local feedback deadlines
observations.resolution: Keep full results in storage; send a complete declared compact feedback projection

observations.finding: Actual local responses exposed empty/truncated envelopes and result-scoped practice without unit IDs
observations.resolution: Use existing bounded projection/repair, fill only harmless metadata, accept result-scoped new practice without invented subject IDs

observations.finding: Late output retained original result/answer but incorrectly marked feedback complete
observations.resolution: Restore commentary metadata from the accepted checkpoint with the result pointer

observations.finding: An actual PostgreSQL feedback-result write failure returned saved grade plus503; browser displayed save failure and no score
observations.resolution: Recognize persisted numeric result as a committed submission; reload saved answer/score and offer feedback-only retry

observations.finding: Actual local RepairPositive returned correct combined detected/correction prose but admission demanded a separate correction card. Repair guidance also used a generic provider failure code.
observations.resolution: Accept combined source-bound factual comments; preserve independent grades and genuine source coverage. Output-invalid errors retain bounded repair guidance. Local test oracle checks grounded subject rather than a presentation kind.
observations.classification: Application format restriction; not linguistic model failure
